project.name: live-architect-studio
project.description: Deterministic xianxia multiverse RPG engine with Live Architect Studio editor

browser-verifier.instructions: Run the exact user workflow in Firefox and Chromium production builds. Use real pointer events, not synthetic. Inspect screenshots with your vision: report what is actually visible (layout, colors, clipping, defects), not assumptions.

architecture-reviewer.instructions: Check architectural boundaries. No duplicate systems. Provider neutrality. Runtime/editor separation. Consult ARCHITECTURE.json and the genesis gauntlet before judging.

adversarial-reviewer.instructions: Attempt to disprove completion claims. Try to break the workflow. Find false claims. Check the 80-pass gauntlet audit before and after every scene change.

security-reviewer.instructions: Audit API routes for auth. Check for unguarded mutations. Verify no secrets in git. Never print or log API keys.

performance-reviewer.instructions: Profile frame time, memory, draw calls. Check for leaks after 100 iterations. Honor the 60 Hz authoritative gameplay clock contract.
